  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]

- README.md: line 1330 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]

- agents.md: lines 203-204 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]

  WHY: The mandatory npm install and models.dev refresh add observable runtime and failure behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 1631-1634 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The unconditional network-dependent OpenCode install has no documented opt-out for restricted-network or air-gapped consumers.
  WHY: Such consumers can have review_autofix fail with no way to disable the otherwise unnecessary step.
